title: Electron Shells and Valency
summary: How electrons are arranged in shells (2, 8, 8), why the outer shell matters, and what valency means.

cbse.chapter: Exploration (2026) Ch 8: Journey Inside the Atom (distribution of electrons, valency)

objectives: I can write the electron arrangement for the first 20 elements.
I can draw Bohr diagrams of atoms.
I can work out valence electrons and valency, and explain why full outer shells are stable.
misconceptions: Electrons can go in any shell in any order.
Every shell holds 8 electrons (the first holds only 2).
Valency is always the number of outer electrons (for 5–7 outer electrons it is 8 minus that).
